note: Sukkah Builder. The rules are the traditional ones (Mishnah, tractate Sukkah, chapter 1) in plain words. The app's own pages say only that a sukkah is a temporary hut with a roof of branches (data/library/articles.json, sukkot); every rule here is held for the owner's review, because details differ between communities. The Torah line is Leviticus 23:42 from the app's Torah text.
review: halachic detail: the four rules below are traditional rules, not yet stated in the app; check before release

rules.sky: The roof covering must be open to the sky: not under a tree, a roof or a balcony.
rules.walls: A sukkah needs at least two full walls and part of a third.
rules.schach: The roof covering (schach) is plant material that grew from the ground and has been cut: branches, bamboo, palm leaves. Not metal, plastic or a living tree.
rules.shade: Inside, in the daytime, there should be more shade than sun.

options.en: In the yard, open to the sky
Under the roof of a covered porch
On a top-floor balcony with nothing above
Two full walls and part of a third
The branches of a tree still growing
More shade than sun, with gaps to see a few stars
So thin that the sun is stronger than the shade

verse.en: In booths you shall live seven days
